topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: You ever had that gut clench when the city decides to take away something you've come to depend on? Like when they say your local watering hole, the one that’s been there since the days of real men and real drinks, has to go? Yeah, well, it’s the same damn story with this restaurant now. They call it progress, maybe I’m just a relic, but to me, it feels like they’re ripping out another piece of what made this place worth standing in the rain for. They can stick their new chains and their shiny facades. I’ll stick with the memories, even if they’re all that’s left.
